authority_interpretation.candidate_rule: 21 D temperatures frozen before any E read; complete D-calibration manifest is listed before the separate E decision
authority_interpretation.formal_rule: D only after model selection; no test access during tuning/debugging/calibration design/early stopping
authority_interpretation.root_authorization: Execute the separately frozen D-only stage and independent arithmetic; no further permission wait; no original formal/E gates or budgets changed.

budget.excludes_unmeasured: Native service startup and orchestration/publication outside the stage; local synthetic preparation is separate.
budget.includes: dispatch setup after entry timestamp, child startup/imports, runtime/input checks, all21 scalar calibrations, independent arithmetic, receipts and supervisor archive/transport preparation
budget.source: Separate D-only allocation under the current remaining-blockers user request and root explicit authorization; original proposed E7200 allocation and original C2 budgets are unchanged.

failure_policy: Preserve every attempted event/receipt/cost; stop fixed-roster campaign on first failure or cap; no retries, altered bounds, new seed/model or post-E recalibration.

independent_arithmetic.comparison_tolerance: 1e-10*max(1,abs(reference)); KKT/bracket sign and raw-vs-calibrated NLL slack1e-10
independent_arithmetic.method: Separate blockwise longdouble reference with different centering/reduction; NLL/gradient/Hessian at raw/lower/upper/final and final bracket, trajectory structure and argmax checks
independent_arithmetic.origin: New implementation consistency criteria declared before D calibration; original 1e-12 relative bracket stopping rule is unchanged.

original_candidate_temperature_rule.endpoints: If derivative at lower endpoint >=0 choose lower; otherwise if derivative at upper endpoint <=0 choose upper; record boundary optimum.
original_candidate_temperature_rule.failure_policy: HOLD before E; no bounds expansion, restarts or post-E recalibration
original_candidate_temperature_rule.flat_exception: If every event has exactly equal logits across all 11 classes, beta=1.
original_candidate_temperature_rule.interior_solver: Bisection on derivative sign; at most 100 iterations; stop when bracket width <=1e-12*max(1,abs(midpoint)) or no representable strict interior point; choose final bracket midpoint.
original_candidate_temperature_rule.objective: unweighted mean multiclass D NLL; stable logsumexp with per-event max-logit centering
original_candidate_temperature_rule.receipt: raw input hashes, finite checks, endpoint gradients, final bracket/beta/NLL and exact argmax agreement
original_candidate_temperature_rule.scope: each already-selected model; independently verified D logits only; freeze 21 temperature results before any E read

runtime_identity_source.scope: Pre-fit pin from actual prior runtime, plus actual named package/native bytes frozen before first D scalar fit and checked afterward.
